title: KKS-Sicim workers’ five-day strike in Aksai/Börli district over wages
reason: Not included as a public anti-state/state-policy protest on available evidence. Reports describe an industrial worksite strike against the private KKS-Sicim joint-venture contractor, with pay and job-grade demands directed mainly to company management; no street/public forum gathering or state-level labor-policy demand is established. Video appeals to the President on Jan 17–18 are not themselves public gatherings.
notes: Tengrinews reports about 500 workers refused work at work sites on Jan 16; Azattyq reports about 100 at the industrial base on Jan 20 and strike ending that afternoon; some workers left for unpaid leave. Location differs across reporting (Aksai vs Pugachevo/Börli district). Do not equate worker headcount with public protest attendance. Reopen only if evidence demonstrates a public gathering and an own-state policy demand.
